title: Episode 2
summary: An adventure game show contestant is found stabbed to death at the end of a zip line.
method: The victim was stabbed with a clothing pin while his backpack was being put on. Because of the painkillers, he didn't feel this. The movement on the zip line and him removing his backpack later accelerated the blood loss. The killer then pretended to help the victim and stab him in the same place with a real knife to hide the real murder weapon. The case was cracked due to the pearl of the clothing pin being found at the scene.
motive: The killer knew that a murder would derail the game show, and wanted to do this for a girl he liked. The showrunner stole the idea for the show from the girl and she's given no credit.
notes: First episode where they introduce Sebastian, although he doesn't join the team until next episode.
